description: Note: OpenOffice Writer is not currently running. Create a formal business letter using Apache OpenOffice Writer. First, open OpenOffice Writer by double-clicking the desktop shortcut or launching from the application menu. Then create a business letter with the following structure and content in this exact order: (1) LETTERHEAD at top: 'Red Hat, Inc.' followed by '100 East Davie Street' followed by 'Raleigh, NC 27601'. (2) DATE: 'February 3, 2026'. (3) RECIPIENT ADDRESS: 'Mr. Arvind Krishna', 'Chairman and CEO', 'IBM Corporation', '1 New Orchard Road', 'Armonk, NY 10504'. (4) SALUTATION: 'Dear Mr. Krishna,'. (5) BODY: Write at least 3 sentences about an open source collaboration initiative discussing enterprise Linux and cloud technology partnership opportunities. (6) CLOSING: 'Respectfully,'. (7) SIGNATURE BLOCK: 'Matt Hicks', 'President and CEO', 'Red Hat, Inc.'. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/partnership_letter.odt' using File > Save As, selecting ODF Text Document format.

metadata.real_data_note: All company names, addresses, and executive names are from publicly available information. Red Hat was acquired by IBM in 2019. Matt Hicks is Red Hat CEO since 2022. Arvind Krishna is IBM CEO since 2020.
metadata.initial_state: Desktop with OpenOffice Writer NOT running - agent must launch the application
